svg.aria-label: The plan chart with each of its seven series, the now marker, the editable slot lanes and the shared time axis numbered, and a key naming them
svg.text: Seven series on one shared time axis, four units on four axes. Every chip in the legend toggles one series and rescales the axes to what is left.

rect.title: Space heating and hot water share these quarter hours: the pump alternates circuits within each step, hot water first. Their combined power never exceeds the heat pump's maximum — this is time-sharing, not double-booking.
